title: Resume output after reconnect and stop idle sessions
description:
As the student, I want a dropped connection not to lose output, and idle sessions to clean themselves up.

Feature: Session resilience
  Scenario: Reconnect resumes the stream
    Given a running session that has produced 10 lines
    When the event stream disconnects and reconnects with the last event id
    Then only the lines after that id are delivered
  Scenario: Idle session shuts down
    Given a session with no activity for the idle timeout
    Then the runner process exits

comments.author: home
comments.text: Specs pass; Fargate end-to-end still to confirm.
